title: IEEE HITC Awards - Call for Nomination - 2026

blocks.text: The IEEE Technical Committee on Hyper-Intelligence (HITC) solicits nominations for its 2026 awards. Each award includes a plaque presented at a selected IEEE HITC sponsored conference, along with a public citation on the IEEE HITC website. Please see each award page for eligibility, required nomination materials and past winners.

Nominations must be submitted via email (as a single PDF file) to the Award Selection Secretary, Xiaokang Zhou (zhou@kansai-u.ac.jp), and CC the Committee Chair, Laurence T. Yang (ltyang@ieee.org). The subject of the nomination email should be named as: HITC + Award Category + Nominee, e.g. HITC-Early Career Award-Obama.

Awardees will be presented a plaque and will be recognized by IEEE HITC in its website, newsletter and archives. The awards for 2026 will be presented at CyberSciTech 2026 (IEEE HITC sponsored conference) - Melbourne, Australia, November 9-13, 2026.
